comment: Deck-building rule modifications and payoff patches that exist only in card text, keyed by fullName. Copy-limit exceptions are data-driven (maxCopiesInDeck) and must NOT be listed here. The pipeline greps deck-rule phrasing against this table; unknown matches are reported for review. Payoff overrides replace any pattern-extracted payoffs for the card; citations reference the Comprehensive Rules and official release notes.

effect.note: GATHER THE PARTY: other Hunny characters can be in the deck regardless of ink type. The card itself is dual-ink and still requires both inks to be declared.

payoffOverrides.citation: Rule 8.10.8 (Shift) + official ruling: Baymax - Amped Up's Shift cost is paid by removing 2 ink-drop counters from your inkwell, not by paying ink (Set 5 'Shimmering Skies' release notes).

MIMICRY ruling: any character with a Shift keyword may be played on top of Morph as if Morph had any name; Classification Shift still requires its classification target, so those Shift variants are excluded.
ADVANCED MIMICRY ruling: any character may be shifted on top of Morph, including all Shift variants (rule 8.10.8.x).

Rule 8.10.8.1 (named Shift; the reminder text is omitted on this printing) + SALVAGE ruling: the 7-ink Shift cost is reduced by 1 ink for each item card in your discard, so the printed cost is conditional.
UNUSUAL TRANSFORMATION ruling: this card only gains Shift 0 while a card left a player's discard this turn, so the Shift ability is conditional rather than innate.
